description.text: A cramped, oil-stained garage presses close around an open engine bay, its concrete floor dark with old spills and its shelves crowded with cans and tools. A single hanging work lamp throws a hard pool of light over the engine, leaving the corners in brown shadow. The older mechanic stands over the bay in worn, grease-darkened work clothes, holding a cracked, frayed drive belt up in one hand. He tilts the failed belt toward the younger mechanic's side of the shot, jaw tight, and speaks with flat certainty while the younger man's shoulder remains visible at the edge of the view.
The older mechanic stands over the open engine bay in the cramped garage, the cracked drive belt raised in his hand.
He tilts the frayed belt toward the younger mechanic and speaks with flat certainty.
A low garage hum and a faint creak from the worn belt fill the room.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

The younger mechanic stands on the opposite side of the engine bay, leaning over the fender with a wrench in his fist. His work shirt is smudged, and the hard work lamp picks out the sweat on his brow and the dull metal of the wrench. He wipes his brow with his forearm, meets the older man's stare, and answers with defensive insistence, chin lifting as he plants his free hand on the valve cover. The older mechanic remains across the bay, still and watchful, the cracked belt held between them.
The younger mechanic leans over the fender with a wrench in his fist.
He wipes his brow, meets the older man's stare, and plants his free hand on the valve cover as he answers defensively.
A small metallic tool clink and the continuing garage hum sit under the exchange.
The camera holds a static shot.
